The required attachments for this position are: • Cover Letter; • Resume; • Reference List ; • Diversity Statement; Have you attached the correct required documents to your application? Options: Yes | No
Valid driver’s license and eligible to obtain California driver’s license upon hire
Associate Degree
Two years of work experience, or combination of education and experience which would indicate possession of knowledge, skills and abilities listed.
Provides basic and routine technical support assistance including software, hardware and LMS to students from a centralized location and online;

Obtains accurate and complete information from customers in person or by telephone to identify their needs and problems and develops responses and solutions for password and basic connectivity issues;
Coordinates help desk coverage to provide service to customers based on call and walk-in patterns;
Develop and maintain online resources for campus technology users including frequently asked questions and solutions
Create, update, track and complete tickets in the ticketing system;
Generate reports, review issues, work with assigned administrator to develop new strategies to maintain effectiveness of student technology support;
Ensure good customer service through friendly, supportive, and positive interaction with customers;
Respond to user questions and inquiries in a timely manner through various forms of communication, demonstration, remote access to computer, and devices to assist users with disabilities;
Follow up with users to ensure the reported problems are fully resolved;
Solve user technical problems remotely or in person;
Perform other related duties as required.
Minimum 12 units of college level courses in computer information systems, office technology, or related areas
Exceptional customer service delivery;
Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the performance of duties; and
Industry standard operating systems (Windows, iOS, Android, Mac OS);

Demonstrate a sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds of staff and students and of staff and students with physical and learning disabilities.
Problem solving/troubleshooting techniques;
Read and comprehend printed matter and text and data on computer monitors;
Standard computer terminology;
Sit or stand for extended periods of time;
Research tools for problem resolution;
Lift and/or carry 25 pounds; and
Current technologies, personal computer, and associated office software such as word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, and/or database software;
Exert manual dexterity sufficient for keyboard and other office equipment operation.
Correct usage of English, grammar, spelling, punctuation, and vocabulary; and
District policies and procedures.
Communicate intelligibly and effectively via speech, telephone, written correspondence, and/or email;
